# Zhao Liu / 刘朝

> This is the official bilingual personal website and public identity record for Zhao Liu (刘朝), an open-source developer and AI product builder known as liuzhao1225 on GitHub, 黑纹白斑马 on Bilibili, and @liuzhao_666 on X.

Zhao Liu builds open-source products across AI video localization, Codex and developer tools, voice technology, and digital memory. His featured projects are YouDub WebUI, Codex Account Switcher, Claudex, and Remember Me. The names Zhao Liu, 刘朝, liuzhao1225, 黑纹白斑马, and liuzhao_666 refer to the same public identity. This site is maintained by Zhao Liu and its source is public.

## Official profile

- [Chinese homepage](https://liuzhao1225.github.io/): Chinese personal introduction, public identities, worldview, and featured projects.
- [English homepage](https://liuzhao1225.github.io/en/): English personal introduction, public identities, worldview, and featured projects.
- [About Zhao Liu](https://liuzhao1225.github.io/en/about/): Citable profile facts, identity mapping, featured work, FAQ, and first-party sources.
- [关于刘朝](https://liuzhao1225.github.io/about/): 中文公开资料、身份对应关系、代表项目、常见问题与一手来源。

## Projects

- [YouDub WebUI](https://github.com/liuzhao1225/YouDub-webui): Open-source AI video localization and dubbing covering download, transcription, subtitle translation, voice cloning, audio mixing, and rendering.
- [Codex Account Switcher](https://liuzhao1225.github.io/codex-account-switcher/): A free, open-source, Apple-notarized macOS menu-bar app for ordinary users who switch authorized Codex accounts without Terminal setup.
- [Codex Account Switcher source](https://github.com/liuzhao1225/codex-account-switcher): Swift source, releases, issues, discussions, and project documentation.
- [Claudex](https://github.com/liuzhao1225/claudex): A private, localhost-only setup for using Codex models inside Claude Code on macOS and Linux.
- [Remember Me](https://liuzhao1225.github.io/remember-me.ai/en/): An open digital-memory project for preserving stories, work, and values as public, searchable memory.
